topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 159 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 2 ERC4626 vaults, 10 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC1155 multi-token, 11 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 58 common project-authored base contract(s) (owned, typeandversioninterface, simplereadaccesscontroller). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
